kind: idealised direct-beam solar energy: an UPPER BOUND, not a power budget and not battery state

panel.formula: E[Wh] = efficiency x area[m^2] x irradiance[W/m^2] x illuminated time[h]

longest_without_direct_sunlight.note: no energy is produced in this interval; if cut off by the window edge, its true length is at least this

geometric.note: same panel against the local horizontal with no terrain (position-independent)

terrain_effect.note: negative: terrain removes sunlight the geometry allows; positive: the terrain horizon lies below the local horizontal

partial_disc_bracket.note: Lower bracket: only periods when the WHOLE Sun disc is above the terrain count. Upper bracket = the headline (any part of the disc). Nominal positions only; no position band for the whole-disc figure.

position_sensitivity.kind: sensitivity of the result to the INPUT observer position; not an error bar on the astronomy or terrain calculation, which are exact for the given inputs
position_sensitivity.limitations: a sample of displacements, not a proven bound; applies only where terrain data support it; assumes the DEM itself is correct
position_sensitivity.method: full recomputation (ephemeris, horizon, visibility, boundary bisection) at displaced positions on a circle of the stated radius; boundary band = [earliest, latest] over the nominal and displaced runs

assumptions: Panel faces the Sun whenever any part of the Sun's disc is above the terrain horizon (sun-tracking; no incidence-angle loss). A fixed panel would produce less.
A partly visible Sun counts as fully illuminating the panel (the whole-disc energy is given as a lower bracket).
Constant irradiance equal to the stated value (default: 1361 W/m^2, the nominal solar constant at 1 AU); the +/-3.4 % Earth-Sun distance variation over the year is not modelled.
Constant panel efficiency, as supplied by the user; no temperature or degradation effect, no dust, no lander self-shadowing.
Terrain is the LOLA DEM horizon; boulders and the lander body are not modelled (see docs/stage9/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md).
limitations: Idealised direct-beam energy: an upper bound, not a power budget and not battery state.

Position sensitivity is carried from the visibility result (+/- the stated position uncertainty); it is a sensitivity to the input position, not an error bar on the physics, and a sample of displacements, not a proven bound.
The whole-disc bracket has no position band (the band is computed for the headline state only).

provenance.reproducibility: deterministic: the same inputs and the same kernels/DEM windows give identical results
